title: Contact Alexander Colón | Call, Text, or Email
description: Call or text (813) 613-8822, email alex@athomewichita.com, or send a question in writing. Nothing starts automatically because you got in touch.
job: Remove every reason not to make contact, and offer more than one way to do it.
primaryPrinciple: Remove friction. Every channel the visitor might prefer, on one screen.

bands.headline: Get in touch
bands.support: Call or text (813) 613-8822, or email alex@athomewichita.com. If you would rather write it out and not talk to anybody yet, the form below goes to the same place.

items.a: Text. Alex is in appointments and showings during the day, and a text gets read between them where a voicemail often does not get returned until the evening.

items.q: What happens after I send this?
items.a: It reaches Alex directly. He answers these himself, so the reply comes from him rather than from an autoresponder pretending to be him.

items.q: Am I signing up for anything?
items.a: No. There is no sequence attached to these forms. One question is one question.

items.q: Can I just ask something without giving my phone number?
items.a: Yes. The phone field is optional, and it is there only so Alex can text you back instead of writing a long email if that would be faster.

bands.heading: Or skip the form entirely
bands.body: There is no advantage to using the form over sending a text. Use whichever one you would actually use.
